test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 03
subject: general
question: Which of the following Articles is related to the Ancillary powers of Supreme Court?
solution:
__
 
• **Article 140**__ deals with the Ancillary powers of the Supreme Court.
 
• Supreme Court of India consists of the Chief Justice of India and a maximum of** 34 judges**.
 
• It was established in the year **1950**.
 
• The seat of the Supreme Court is declared as **Delhi **by the Constitution of India.
 
• **65 years** is the age of retirement for the judge of the supreme court.
 
• __**Harilal J. Kania**__ was the first Chief Justice of India.
 
• The 52nd and present Chief Justice is Bhushan Gavai. Sworn in on 14 May, 2025, he became the first Buddhist to hold this post. He will have a 6-month term which is due to end on November 23, 2025.
